scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Would you like to reset skills?
I'm sorry, but...
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
想重置技能吗？
很抱歉，不过……

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Hello, I am the Skill Resetter.
Your name is ^0080FF{0}^000000.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
你好，我是技能重置师。
你的名字是 ^0080FF{0}^000000。
有什么可以帮你？

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
I already told you that you may only complete this event once.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
我已经告诉过你，这个活动只能参加一次。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Please return when you reach BaseLv 60 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
基础等级达到 60 级或更高后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
You will need to use up all of your skill points if you want me to continue.
Please come again soon!
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
想让我继续的话，你必须先用完所有技能点。
请尽快再来！

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Please, drop your cart and we'll continue.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
请先卸下手推车，我们再继续。

scripts.text: [^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]

[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Please, free your Falcon and we'll continue.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
请先解除猎鹰，我们再继续。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
You cannot reset skills
when you keep
any items.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
携带物品时
无法重置技能。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Please, free your PecoPeco and we'll continue.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
请先解除大嘴鸟，我们再继续。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Come back soon!
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
欢迎很快再来！

scripts.text: ^009500Information about Reset skills.^000000
^00B6FFReset skills.^000000

[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
You know where to find me,
if you ever want a reset!!
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
想重置的话，
你知道该去哪里找我！！

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
This skill reset is not FREE OF CHARGE!!
Expense for the reset of skill is ^D5A50020000 Zeny x BaseLv^000000.
Yeah ...each One BaseLv costs 20000 Zeny to reset skill.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
技能重置可不是免费的！！
重置技能的费用为 ^D5A50020000 Zeny × BaseLv^000000。
没错……每个基础等级需要 20000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Oh yeah, one more thing!
Any carts, falcons or pecos you have equiped
will be removed if you reset your skills.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
对了，还有一件事！
重置技能时，你装备的手推车、猎鹰或大嘴鸟
都会被解除。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Just one time does again to shake the skill point
Careful with your skills from here on.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
技能重置只能使用一次，重新分配技能点后，
今后请谨慎选择技能。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Before skill reset in starting.
You shall have to first tell me your Base Level.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
开始重置技能前，
请先告诉我你的基础等级。

scripts.text:
^D5A500[{0}]^000000
My Base level is ^AA00AALevel {1}BaseLv.^000000

[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Total zeny to the reset of skill amount ^529DFF{0}Zeny^000000  for the skill reset service.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
技能重置服务的总费用为 ^529DFF{0} Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
It seems that you don't have enough money.
In addition we wait for the opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[^D5A500催眠师^000000]
看来你的钱不够。
等准备好费用后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[^D5A500Hypnotist^000000]
Thank you.
